maneuver_<N>: Holds driver avoidance maneuvers — one row per vehicle (state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number) with driver_maneuvered_to_avoid and driver_maneuvered_to_avoid_name; state_name present in some variants (keys: state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number).
vsoe_<N>: Holds vehicle sequence-of-events records — one row per vehicle event (state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, vehicle_event_number) with sequence_of_events, sequence_of_events_name, area_of_Impact_associated_with_the_event, area_of_Impact_associated_with_the_event_name (keys: state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, vehicle_event_number).
safetyeq_<N>: Holds non-motorist safety equipment usage — one row per person-on-vehicle (state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, person_number) with non_motorist_safety_equipment_use (keys: state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, person_number).
nmcrash_<N>: Holds non-motorist contributing circumstances — one row per non-motorist (state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, person_number) with non_motorist_contributing_circumstances and non_motorist_contributing_circumstances_name (keys: state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, person_number).
drimpair_<N>: Holds driver impairment conditions — one row per vehicle (state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number) with condition_impairment_at_time_of_crash_driver and condition_impairment_at_time_of_crash_driver_name; some variants include state_name (keys: state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number).
person_<N>: Person- and vehicle-level attributes for each person record; grain = one row per person on a form (state_number, consecutive_number, person_number, vehicle_number) with crash/time keys (county, day_of_crash, month_of_crash, hour_of_crash, minute_of_crash, year in accident table), vehicle context (number_of_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit, number_of_motor_vehicle_striking_non_motorist, vehicle_make/vehicle_make_name, make_model_combined, body_type/body_type_name, vehicle_trailing, special_use/special_use_name, emergency_motor_vehicle_use, rollover, initial_contact_point/initial_contact_point_name, fire_occurrence), person demographics and outcomes (age, sex, person_type/person_type_name, injury_severity/injury_severity_name, seating_position) and location/context (land_use/land_use_name, functional_system/functional_system_name, first_harmful_event/first_harmful_event_name, manner_of_collision/manner_of_collision_name, school_bus_related).
factor_<N>: Motor vehicle contributing factors; grain = one row per vehicle-factor record (state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number) containing contributing_circumstances_motor_vehicle and contributing_circumstances_motor_vehicle_name.
damage_<N>: Vehicle damage area details; grain = one row per vehicle damage record (state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number) with damaged_areas and damaged_areas_name.
accident_<N>: Crash-level master record; grain = one row per crash (state_number, consecutive_number) with counts and identifiers (number_of_vehicle_forms_submitted_all, number_of_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit, number_of_parked_working_vehicles, number_of_forms_submitted_for_persons_not_in_motor_vehicles, number_of_persons_not_in_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit, number_of_persons_in_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit, number_of_forms_submitted_for_persons_in_motor_vehicles), location/time keys (county, city, day_of_crash, month_of_crash, year_of_crash, day_of_week, hour_of_crash, minute_of_crash, latitude, longitude, milepoint, trafficway_identifier, trafficway_identifier_2), roadway descriptors (national_highway_system, land_use/land_use_name, functional_system/functional_system_name, ownership/ownership_name, route_signing/route_signing_name, special_jurisdiction/special_jurisdiction_name) and crash characterization fields (first_harmful_event/first_harmful_event_name, manner_of_collision/manner_of_collision_name, relation_to_junction_within_interchange_area, relation_to_junction_specific_location).
violatn_<N>: Entity: violations charged to a vehicle; Grain: one row per state_number + consecutive_number + vehicle_number + (violation record) (violations_charged may be multi-valued per row); Notable keys/measures: state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, violations_charged, violations_charged_name
vevent_<N>: Entity: vehicle event details (vehicle-centered events in a crash); Grain: one row per state_number + consecutive_number + vehicle_number + vehicle_event_number (single event for a vehicle); Notable keys/measures: state_number, state_name, consecutive_number, event_number, vehicle_number, vehicle_event_number, vehicle_number_this_vehicle, area_of_impact_this_vehicle, area_of_impact_this_vehicle_name, sequence_of_events, sequence_of_events_name, vehicle_number_other_vehicle, vehicle_number_other_vehicle_name, area_of_impact_other_vehicle, area_of_impact_other_vehicle_name
parkwork_<N>: Entity: vehicle/occupant and crash context (detailed); Grain: one row per state_number + consecutive_number + vehicle_number (vehicle-level crash/parkwork record); Notable keys/measures: state_number, state_name, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, number_of_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit, number_of_occupants, number_of_occupants_name, day_of_crash, day_of_crash_name, month_of_crash, month_of_crash_name, hour_of_crash, hour_of_crash_name, minute_of_crash, minute_of_crash_name, first_harmful_event, first_harmful_event_name, manner_of_collision, manner_of_collision_name, unit_type, unit_type_name, hit_and_run, hit_and_run_name, registration_state, registration_state_name, registered_vehicle_owner, registered_vehicle_owner_name, vehicle_make, vehicle_make_name, vehicle_model, make_model_combined, body_type, body_type_name, vehicle_model_year, vehicle_model_year_name, vehicle_identification_number_vin, vehicle_identification_number_vin_name, vin_character_1, vin_character_2, vin_character_3
nmimpair_<N>: Entity: non-motorist impairment condition at crash; Grain: one row per state_number + consecutive_number + person_number (impairment instance for a non-motorist); Notable keys/measures: state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, person_number, condition_impairment_at_time_of_crash_non_motorist, condition_impairment_at_time_of_crash_non_motorist_name
nmprior_<N>: Entity: non-motorist prior actions; Grain: one row per state_number + consecutive_number + person_number (prior action instance for a non-motorist); Notable keys/measures: state_number, state_name, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, person_number, non_motorist_action_circumstances, non_motorist_action_circumstances_name
vehicle_<N>: Entity: vehicle involved in a crash; Grain: one row per vehicle (per crash) identified by state_number + consecutive_number + vehicle_number; Notable keys/measures: state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, number_of_motor_vehicles_in_transport_mvit, number_of_occupants, day_of_crash, month_of_crash, hour_of_crash, minute_of_crash, first_harmful_event, first_harmful_event_name, manner_of_collision, unit_type, hit_and_run, registration_state, registration_state_name, registered_vehicle_owner, registered_vehicle_owner_name, vehicle_make, vehicle_make_name, vehicle_model, make_model_combined, body_type, body_type_name, vehicle_model_year, vehicle_identification_number_vin and vin_character_1 through vin_character_12, vehicle_trailing, jackknife.
cevent_<N>: Entity: collision/event involvement details for vehicles in a crash; Grain: one row per event occurrence associated with a vehicle (per crash) identified by state_number + consecutive_number + event_number; Notable keys/measures: state_number, consecutive_number, event_number, vehicle_number_this_vehicle, area_of_impact_this_vehicle, area_of_impact_this_vehicle_name, sequence_of_events, sequence_of_events_name, vehicle_number_other_vehicle, area_of_impact_other_vehicle, area_of_impact_other_vehicle_name.
